preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'WORK_RELATED_WORKS'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'WORK_RELATED_WORKS';

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('CREATE', 'READ', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'WORK_RELATED_WORKS';

changeSet.author: foremen

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id WHERE r.code <> 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'WORK_RELATED_WORKS'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT DISTINCT src.role_id, tgt.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM role_resources src JOIN resources catalog ON catalog.id = src.resource_id AND catalog.code = 'WORK_CATALOG' JOIN roles r ON r.id = src.role_id AND r.code <> 'ADMIN' JOIN resources tgt ON tgt.code = 'WORK_RELATED_WORKS';

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT new_rr.id, src_op.operation_id FROM role_resources src JOIN resources catalog ON catalog.id = src.resource_id AND catalog.code = 'WORK_CATALOG' JOIN roles r ON r.id = src.role_id AND r.code <> 'ADMIN' JOIN role_resource_operations src_op ON src_op.role_resource_id = src.id JOIN resources tgt ON tgt.code = 'WORK_RELATED_WORKS' JOIN role_resources new_rr ON new_rr.role_id = src.role_id AND new_rr.resource_id = tgt.id;
